camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribePrivateAssetEnis --region cn-hangzhou --RegionNo 'cn-hangzhou' --VswInstanceIdList.1 'vsw-bp1example' --AssociatedInstanceName 'example-instance' --PrivateIpAddress '10.0.0.10' --EniInstanceIdList.1 'eni-bp1example' --PageSize 10 --MemberUid 1234567890123456 --EniType Primary --Page 1 --TractionStatus.1 1 --AssociatedInstanceIdList.1 'i-bp1example' --VpcInstanceId 'vpc-bp1example' --EniInstanceName 'example-eni' --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC)), associated instances, private IP addresses, and accessed states in a specified VPC by paging
description_zh: 分页查询指定 VPC 下的弹性网卡及其关联实例、私网 IP 和接入状态
kebab_example: aliyun ndr describe-private-asset-enis --vpc-instance-id vpc-bp1example --vsw-instance-id-list vsw-bp1example --traction-status 1 --eni-instance-id-list eni-bp1example --eni-instance-name example-eni --eni-type Primary --associated-instance-id-list i-bp1example --associated-instance-name example-instance --page 1 --page-size 10 --region-no cn-hangzhou --member-uid 1234567890123456 --private-ip-address 10.0.0.10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePrivateAssetEnis

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch instance IDs. If you do not specify this parameter, ENIs are not filtered by vSwitch
parameters.help_zh: 交换机实例 ID 列表。不传时不按交换机筛选
parameters.name: vsw_instance_id_list

parameters.help_en: The accessed state of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC)). A value of 0 indicates that the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC)) is not accessed. A value of 1 indicates that the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC)) is accessed
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡接入状态。0 表示未接入，1 表示已接入
parameters.name: traction_status

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC))
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡实例 ID 列表
parameters.name: eni_instance_id_list

parameters.help_en: The name of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC))
parameters.name: eni_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC)). A value of Primary indicates a primary network interface controller (NIC). A value of Secondary indicates a secondary elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC))
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡类型。Primary 表示主网卡，Secondary 表示辅助弹性网卡
parameters.name: eni_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instances associated with the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC))
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡关联的实例 ID 列表
parameters.name: associated_instance_id_list

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance associated with the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC))
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡关联的实例名称
parameters.name: associated_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member account. If you do not specify this parameter, the current account is used
parameters.help_zh: 成员账号 UID。不传时使用当前账号
parameters.name: member_uid

List.description_en: The list of records that meet the filter conditions

AssociatedInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance associated with the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC))
AssociatedInstanceId.description_zh: 弹性网卡关联的实例 ID

AssociatedInstanceName.description_en: The name of the instance associated with the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC))
AssociatedInstanceName.description_zh: 弹性网卡关联的实例名称

CloudType.description_en: The cloud asset type. A value of ecs indicates Elastic Compute Service (ECS). A value of eci indicates Elastic Container Instance (ECI). A value of acs indicates Container Compute Service (ACS)
CloudType.description_zh: 云资产类型。ecs 表示云服务器 ECS，eci 表示弹性容器实例 ECI，acs 表示容器计算服务 ACS

EniType.description_en: The type of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC)). A value of Primary indicates a primary network interface controller (NIC). A value of Secondary indicates a secondary elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC))
EniType.description_zh: 弹性网卡类型。Primary 表示主网卡，Secondary 表示辅助弹性网卡

InstanceStatus.description_en: The running status of the ECS instance. Valid values: Running: The instance is running. Stopped: The instance is stopped. Stopping: The instance is being stopped. Starting: The instance is being started. This field is not returned for non-ECS assets or when the status has not been synchronized. You cannot add private network collection for ECS instances in the Stopped or Stopping state, but you can stop existing collection tasks
InstanceStatus.description_zh: ECS 实例运行状态。Running 表示运行中，Stopped 表示已停止，Stopping 表示停止中，Starting 表示启动中。非 ECS 资产或状态尚未同步时不返回该字段。处于 Stopped 或 Stopping 状态的 ECS 实例不允许新增私网采集，已有采集仍可停止

IntranetIpList.description_en: The private IP addresses of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC))
IntranetIpList.description_zh: 弹性网卡的私网 IP 地址列表

items.description_zh: 一个私网 IP 地址

IsPrimary.description_en: Indicates whether the private IP address is the primary private IP address
IsPrimary.description_zh: 是否为主私网 IP 地址

ServiceManaged.description_en: Indicates whether the ENI is managed by a cloud service. A value of 0 indicates no. A value of 1 indicates yes
ServiceManaged.description_zh: 是否为云服务托管网卡。0 表示否，1 表示是

TractionStatus.description_en: The accessed state of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC)). A value of 0 indicates that the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC)) is not accessed. A value of 1 indicates that the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) (network interface controller (NIC)) is accessed
TractionStatus.description_zh: 弹性网卡接入状态。0 表示未接入，1 表示已接入

VswInstanceId.description_en: The vSwitch instance ID. This parameter is required when an existing vSwitch is used
VswInstanceId.description_zh: 交换机实例 ID。使用已有交换机时必填

Page.description_en: The page number. Pages start from 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries to return on each page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that meet the filter conditions
